exact_theorem.block_local_object: Each row recomputes the literal weighted operator and its square-energy normalization on one declared block only.
exact_theorem.envelopes: For each finite real symmetric block matrix, the spectral norm is bounded by its Schur and Frobenius envelopes.
exact_theorem.geometry: Every block-local geometry is a finite sum of nonnegative rational squares.
exact_theorem.origin_protocol: The three origins are inherited deterministic grid points declared without response or geometry ranking.
exact_theorem.partition: Each count-2048 window is partitioned into eight fixed contiguous blocks of 256 integers before block-local replay.

origin_protocol.selection_rule: inherited response-blind equally spaced grid points

protocol.partition: eight contiguous blocks of length 256; no response ranking
